head: 8610102d89a4c122e088205eb46739590c6a477e
purpose: Inventory of PQ-017 validation/iteration guard components reusable for a generic Phase 1 broker. Phase 0 only — no extraction yet.

sourceListsAreTheManifest.note: ROUTE_SOURCES + REGRESSION_SOURCES are the digests' input set — the closest thing to a validation manifest today.

components.name: digestPq017Sources
components.behavior: sha256 over stableJson of relativePath→sourceText map

components.name: derivePq017FailureIdentity
components.behavior: Builds slugged identity fields → family path + sha256 fingerprint

components.name: evaluatePq017FastGate
components.behavior: Pass if no unresolved primary failure, newer accepted evidence, or regression digest changed; else block requiring regression

components.name: createPq017FastGateReceipt
components.behavior: Factory for spaceface.pq017-fast-gate.v1 receipt with route/regression digests + optional failure ack fingerprint

components.name: evaluatePq017AcceptanceGate
components.behavior: Requires explicit acceptance/diagnostic flags, current receipt matching digests, and failure-ack coverage when latest failure open

components.name: computePq017GateDigests
components.behavior: Reads ROUTE_SOURCES + REGRESSION_SOURCES from disk; returns { routeDigest, regressionDigest }

components.name: claimPq017FastGateReceipt
components.behavior: Atomic rename claim of fast-gate receipt for exclusive consumption

components.name: acquirePq017FastRunLock
components.behavior: wx-create fast-run.lock with pid token; null if already locked

components.name: publishPq017AcceptanceFailure
components.behavior: Persists failure pointer + family fingerprint for later gates

components.name: publishPq017FastGateReceipt
components.behavior: Atomic write of fast-gate receipt JSON

components.name: loadPq017GateState
components.behavior: Aggregates digests + latestFailure + receipt + accepted evidence timestamps

components.name: assertPq017ProbeLaunch
components.behavior: Launch arbiter: mode flags, claim receipt, evaluate acceptance gate, mark claim inflight or throw

siblingConsumers.role: tick-indexed closed-loop control harness; imports transitionFlightKeyState for replays
public control trajectory generator for PQ-017 routes

phase1ExtractionNotes: Generalize naming off PQ-017 while preserving receipt schema migration path.
Parameterize ROUTE_SOURCES/REGRESSION_SOURCES as injectable manifest lists.
Keep atomic claim/lock semantics — they are the non-repeat iteration control plane.
Do not couple broker extraction to browser/Electron launches in Phase 1 scaffolding.
